verdicts.reason: A is weaker overall. It tries a left-to-right banner layout, but the CTA wraps awkwardly onto two lines ('Shop the / Summer Line') and is pushed against the right edge, where a bokeh dot sits on 'Summer Line'. The headline is off-centre, which leaves a dead area on the left, and the logo is tiny and floats centred, so it doesn't line up with either the headline or the CTA. B is clean, aligned and faithful, but it is basically the original shrunk into a centred stack. Its headline, CTA and logo are small for the banner, the wide sides are empty, and the layout was not rearranged for the new shape.
